title: German Corn Fritters
description: Crunchy and savory corn fritters with a hint of German flavor, perfect as a side dish or snack.

ingredients.name: Grated Canadian cheddar
ingredients.notes: can be omitted for a dairy-free option

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, cheddar cheese, and bake powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk together warm water, egg, salt, and pepper.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop the dough into the hot oil to form small fritters.
Fry the fritters until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve hot.
